## Platform → n8n → CRM: engagement metrics
Every 6 hours (or manually), builds yesterday's (UTC) metrics per post and POSTs each one, HMAC-signed with `MARKETING_N8N_INBOUND_SECRET`, to `{CRM_BASE_URL}/api/marketing/webhooks/metrics`.

**Simulation:** "Fetch platform metrics" generates deterministic sample numbers for the CRM post ids in `SIMULATED_POST_IDS` (comma-separated, PUBLISHED posts). Replace it with real insights calls (Graph API `/{media-id}/insights`, TikTok `video/query`) returning the same item shape.
